name: India
sub: Solid Waste Management Rules 2026: four streams, mandatory since 1 April 2026.

banana.w: Food scraps compost. Keeping them out of dry waste keeps paper and plastic clean.

eggshell.w: Shells are food waste and break down with the rest of the wet stream.

coffee.w: Grounds are rich compost material, so they belong with wet waste.

bones.w: Bones are food waste, even though they break down slowly.

shampoo.w: Empty, rinsed plastic bottles are dry waste.

polybag.w: Clean, dry polybags are dry waste. Food-soiled plastic contaminates the dry load.

chips.w: It looks like foil but it's mostly plastic film. Dry waste.

tube.w: Squeeze it empty. The tube is dry waste.

carton.w: Cartons are about 70% paperboard with plastic and aluminium layers. Rinse, flatten, dry waste.

eggtray.w: Moulded pulp is paper, so it's dry waste.

box.w: Flatten boxes before they go in with dry waste.

pizza.w: Scrape off the food first. A little grease is fine; cheese-covered parts go in wet waste.

newspaper.w: Clean paper is dry waste and one of the most valuable recyclables.

jar.w: Whole glass jars are dry waste. Keep them whole; broken glass is special care.

wine.w: Whole glass bottles are dry waste.

perfume.w: It's glass packaging, so it's dry waste. UK surveys find this is the most-missed recyclable.

tin.w: Rinsed metal tins are dry waste.

window.w: Broken glass is special care under the 2026 rules. It injures waste workers and needs separate handling.

drinkglass.w: Broken glass of any kind is special care.

mirror.w: Broken glass is special care, and the mirror coating makes it worse for glass recycling.

tissue.w: Used tissues are sanitary waste. Wrap them so workers don't handle them.

diaper.w: Diapers are sanitary waste. Wrap them before disposal.

pad.w: Wrap it in paper and put it in sanitary waste.

battery.w: Batteries contain toxic metals and can start fires. Special care.

bulb.w: CFL bulbs contain mercury, so they're special care.

meds.w: Medicines are special care. Never flush them.

paint.w: Leftover paint is special care. It pollutes water if dumped.

toy.w: Clean plastic items go with dry waste.
